Each cell: 32 Normal spins in CortenForge's Langevin drum with a magnet of 0.8x the flattening field, 1.5 strip pitches under the slot, scored against the clean night's best set.
Passed or robbed: within 20 points of the clean night's rate, or more than 20 under it.
